## 1. File: `DEPT_CODES.md`

```markdown:DEPT_CODES.md
# BSc Applied Science Department Codes

When students register with roll numbers starting with **"S"**, they are from **B.Sc. Applied Science**.

## Department Code Reference

### BACHELOR OF ENGINEERING (B.E.)
- **A** → Automobile Engineering
- **C** → Civil Engineering  
- **D** → Biomedical Engineering
- **E** → Electrical & Electronics Engineering
- **L** → Electronics & Communication Engineering
- **M** → Mechanical Engineering
- **N** → Computer Science (AI & ML)
- **P** → Production Engineering
- **R** → Robotics & Automation
- **U** → Instrumentation & Control Engineering
- **Y** → Metallurgical Engineering
- **Z** → Computer Science & Engineering

### BACHELOR OF TECHNOLOGY (B.Tech.)
- **B** → Bio Technology
- **H** → Fashion Technology
- **I** → Information Technology
- **T** → Textile Technology

### BACHELOR OF SCIENCE (B.Sc.)
- **S** → B.Sc. Applied Science
- **X** → Other B.Sc. programs

### MASTER OF ENGINEERING (M.E.)
- **AE** → Automotive Engineering
- **BT** → Biotechnology (M.E.)
- **CS** → Computer Science (M.E.)
- **ED** → Engineering Design (M.E.)
- **EE** → Embedded & Real-Time Systems
- **LN** → VLSI Design (M.E.)
- **LV** → Communication Systems (M.E.)
- **MD** → Manufacturing Engineering / Mechanical Design
- **MN** → Mechatronics (M.E.)
- **NB** → Biometrics & Cybersecurity
- **PP** → Power Systems / Production (M.E.)
- **SE** → Structural Engineering (M.E.)
- **TT** → Textile Technology (M.E.)
- **UC** → Control Systems
- **ZC** → Computer Science & Engineering (M.E.)

### MASTER OF COMPUTER APPLICATIONS (MCA)
- **MX** → MCA

### MASTER OF SCIENCE (M.Sc.)
- **FD** → M.Sc. Fashion Design
- **SA** → M.Sc. Applied Science
- **XC** → M.Sc. Chemistry
- **XD** → M.Sc. Data Science
- **XT** → M.Sc. Textile Science
- **XW** → M.Sc. (other programs)

### MASTER OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (MBA)
- **GM** → MBA General Management
- **GW** → MBA (other specializations)

---

## How Roll Numbers Work

PSG Tech roll numbers follow this format: `[Year][Dept Code][Number]`

**Examples:**
- `23S042` → 2023 batch, B.Sc. Applied Science, student #42
- `24Z105` → 2024 batch, CSE, student #105
- `22M220` → 2022 batch, Mechanical Engineering, student #220

The system auto-detects department from the roll number's middle letter(s).
```

## 2. File: `README.md`

- **File Size**: 2.15 KB
- **Format**: `markdown`

````markdown:README.md
# PSG Bunker Web

> The dedicated attendance tracker, bunk planner, and academic hub for PSG College of Technology students.

---

## 🌟 Highlights

* **Direct eCampus Portal Sync**: Real-time attendance percentage, conducted hours, and subject attendance registers.
* **Safe Bunk Calculator**: Automatic threshold projection ensuring attendance stays strictly above the mandatory 75% limit.
* **Universal Mobile PWA**: Instant 1-tap installation on Android and iOS (Safari "Add to Home Screen") with 0ms offline app shell caching.
* **Academic Calendar Hub**: Real-time CA test schedules, semester timetable, and official holidays.
* **Continuous Assessment (CA) Marks**: Subject-wise internal test scores, assignment marks, and GPA calculator.
* **Vercel Hobby Plan Optimized**:
  * Response Gzip compression middleware (saving >85% bandwidth).
  * Direct client phone calendar fetching (0 Vercel function calls).
  * In-memory session pooling (sub-200ms consecutive calls).
  * Edge region Mumbai (`bom1`) deployment.
  * 24-hour navigation auto-fetch cooldown.

---

## 🚀 Tech Stack

* **Backend**: Python 3.11, Flask WSGI, BeautifulSoup4, Requests
* **Frontend**: HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, FontAwesome, Anime.js
* **PWA**: Service Worker Cache API (`bunker-cache-v32`), Web App Manifest
* **Deployment**: Vercel Serverless Functions (`bom1` region)

---

## 🛠️ Local Development

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/akka-pixel/bunker-web.git
   cd bunker-web
   ```

2. **Set up virtual environment & install dependencies:**
   ```bash
   python3 -m venv venv
   source venv/bin/activate
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```

3. **Run development server:**
   ```bash
   python3 -m flask --app api.index run --port 5000
   ```

4. **Open in browser:**
   ```
   http://localhost:5000
   ```

---

## 📱 Mobile Installation (PWA)

* **Android (Chrome)**: Tap the in-app "Install Bunker App" card or browser menu (⋮) -> *Install app*.
* **iOS (Safari)**: Tap the Share button (<i class="fas fa-arrow-up-from-bracket"></i>) -> *Add to Home Screen*.

---

## 📄 License

MIT License. Built with ❤️ for PSG Tech students.
````

```text:public/assets/aistudio/Paste_October_25__2026_-_6_43AM_e2052e3d
   Reverse-Engineering Specification: PSG College of Technology Student Portals 

  Comprehensive technical documentation reverse-engineered from live sessions of both the Modern Portal (https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/)
  and Classic Portal (https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone2/) to upgrade the PSG Bunker web application.
  ──────
   Part A — Modern Portal (https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/) 

  ## 1. Main Dashboard & Profile

  ### 1.1 Main Dashboard (/studzone/Home/Menu)

  • Endpoint URL & Method: GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Home/Menu
  • Authentication: ASP.NET Core session cookie (.AspNetCore.Cookies, ASP.NET_SessionId)
  • DOM Selectors:
      • Main Cards Container: div.container.menu-container > div.row
      • Menu Cards: div.card.menu-card
      • Dropdown User Icon: span#profileIcon
      • Offcanvas Password Form: div#offcanvasRight form#change-password-form (Action: /studzone/Home/ChangePaswword, Method: POST)


  #### Navigation Links & Endpoints on /Home/Menu

   Menu Card Title │ Destination URL                                 │ Method     │ Purpose
  ─────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Attendance      │ /studzone/Attendance/AttendanceMenu             │ GET        │ Attendance overview, Timetable, Course plan
   CA              │ /studzone/ContinuousAssessment/CAMenu           │ GET        │ Continuous assessment marks & CA test schedules
   Feedback        │ /studzone/Feedback/Index                        │ GET        │ Intermediate & End-Semester faculty feedback
   Fees            │ /studzone/Fees/FeesMenu                         │ GET        │ Semester tuition fee portal (/Fees/Fees)
   Hostel          │ /studzone/Hostel/Index                          │ GET        │ Hostel fee payment (/Hostel/PaymentStart)
   Scholarships    │ /studzone/Scholar/Index                         │ GET        │ Institutional and government scholarship status
   My Profile      │ /studzone/Home/Profile                          │ GET        │ Student biographical, batch, and residence data
   Change Password │ #offcanvasRight → /studzone/Home/ChangePaswword │ POST       │ Password update (currentpassword, newpassword, confirmpassword)
   Logout          │ /studzone/Login/Logout                          │ GET        │ Session invalidation and cookie wipe

  #### Raw HTML Snippet (.menu-container)

  #### Student Leave Entry (/studzone/Attendance/leaveentry)

  • Endpoint URL & Method: POST https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Attendance/SubmitLeaveentry
  • Payload Schema (multipart/form-data or x-www-form-urlencoded):
      • Submit.Fromdate: DD/MM/YYYY
      • Submit.Todate: DD/MM/YYYY
      • Submit.FromSession: F (Forenoon) or A (Afternoon)
      • Submit.ToSession: F or A
      • Submit.LeaveType: L (Leave), M (Medical), or E (Exemption/OD)
      • Submit.FromHour: 1 to 12
      • Submit.ToHour: 1 to 12
      • Submit.Reason: Plain text string (≤ 45 characters)
      • __RequestVerificationToken: Anti-forgery token from <input name="__RequestVerificationToken">

  ## 3. Continuous Assessment Module (/studzone/ContinuousAssessment/CAMenu)

  ### 3.1 CA Marks View (/studzone/ContinuousAssessment/CAMarksView)

  • Endpoint URL & Method: GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/ContinuousAssessment/CAMarksView
  • Container: div.table-responsive.mt-4
  • Table Classes: table.table-bordered.table-striped

  The page contains 5 distinct dynamic tables based on subject regulation:

  #### Table 1: Laboratory Assessment (IR & PLRO)

  • Header Row 1 (<th>): COURSE CODE, COURSE TITLE, IR I, IR II, PLRO I, PLRO II, Total, Conv. Total
  • Header Row 2 (<th>): Max: 15, Max: 15, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 50, Max: 60
  • Index Mapping:
      • td[0]: Course Code (e.g. 23U310)
      • td[1]: Course Title (e.g. SENSORS AND TRANSDUCERS LABORATORY)
      • td[2]: Internal Review 1 (IR I, Max: 15)
      • td[3]: Internal Review 2 (IR II, Max: 15)
      • td[4]: Practical Lab Record Observation 1 (PLRO I, Max: 10)
      • td[5]: Practical Lab Record Observation 2 (PLRO II, Max: 10)
      • td[6]: Total (Max: 50)
      • td[7]: Converted Total (Max: 60)


  #### Table 2: Theory Course with Tutorial (AT1 & AT 2)

  • Header Row 1 (<th>): COURSE CODE, COURSE TITLE, T1, T2, RT, RT 1, RT 2, Total (Best 2 TESTS), AT1, AT 2, MQ 1, MQ 2, Total (Best 2 MCQs), Total,
  Conv. Total
  • Header Row 2 (<th>): Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 5, Max: 5, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 50, Max: 40
  • Index Mapping:
      • td[0]: Course Code (e.g. 23U301)
      • td[1]: Course Title (e.g. LINEAR ALGEBRA)
      • td[2..4]: Test 1 (T1), Test 2 (T2), Retest (RT, RT 1, RT 2) (Max: 30 each)
      • td[7]: Total of Best 2 Tests (Max: 30)
      • td[8]: Assignment/Tutorial 1 (AT1, Max: 5)
      • td[9]: Assignment/Tutorial 2 (AT 2, Max: 5)
      • td[10..11]: Online Quiz / MCQ 1 & 2 (MQ 1, MQ 2, Max: 10 each)
      • td[12]: Total of Best 2 MCQs (Max: 10)
      • td[13]: Total Internal (Max: 50)
      • td[14]: Converted Final CA (Max: 40)


  #### Table 3: Theory Course without Tutorial (Assignment Presentation AP)

  • Header Row 1 (<th>): COURSE CODE, COURSE TITLE, T1, T2, RT, RT 1, RT 2, Total (Best 2 TESTS), AP, MQ 1, MQ 2, Total (Best 2 MCQs), Total, Conv.
  Total
  • Header Row 2 (<th>): Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 30, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 10, Max: 50, Max: 40
  • Index Mapping:
      • td[8]: Assignment Presentation (AP, Max: 10) in place of AT1/AT2

  • Header Row 1 (<th>): COURSE CODE, COURSE TITLE, A I, A II, Total, Conv. Total
  • Header Row 2 (<th>): Max: 50, Max: 50, Max: 100, Max: 100

  #### Table 5: Activity Point Programme & Experiential Learning

  • Header Row 1 (<th>): COURSE CODE, COURSE TITLE, EH, Total, Conv. Total
  • Header Row 2 (<th>): Max: 150, Max: 150, Max: 100

  ## 4. Feedback Module (/studzone/Feedback/Index)

  ### 4.1 Architecture & Workflow

  The student feedback system runs in two cycles:

  1. Intermediate Feedback: Mid-semester subjective assessment per question carousel.
  2. End-Semester Feedback: Final comprehensive 5-star rating matrix per faculty.

  ### 4.2 Intermediate Feedback Endpoints

  1. Fetch Staff List:
      • GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/Intermediate
      • Yields staff cards with onclick="openQuestionSet(staffId, courseCode, courseType)".
  2. Fetch Questions & Options (XHR):
      • URL: GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/IntermediateAnsList
      • Query Parameters:
          • coursecode: e.g. 23U301
          • staffId: e.g. C3565
          • quesID: Active question ID from carousel div.carousel-item.active[data-ques-id]
      • Response Format:
        [
          {
            "ansId": 1,
            "ansDesc": "Clearly explained with real-world examples",
            "selectedAns": 0
          },
          {
            "ansId": 2,
            "ansDesc": "Satisfactory explanation",
            "selectedAns": 0
          }
        ]

  3. Submit Answer (XHR):
      • URL: POST https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/Save_Intermediate
      • Payload (application/x-www-form-urlencoded):
          • coursecode: 23U301
          • staffId: C3565
          • questype: 1
          • quesID: 102
          • ansid: 1
      • Anti-Forgery Token: Not required (validated via session cookie).


  ### 4.3 End-Semester Feedback Endpoints

  1. Fetch Staff Evaluation Matrix:
      • GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/LoadStaffs_endSem
      • Response: [{"staffId": "C3565", "courseCode": "23U301", "courseType": "1", "staffName": "Dr. PREETHI S"}]
  2. Fetch Questions:
      • GET https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/LoadQuestions_endSem?coursecode=23U301&coursetype=1
      • Response: [{"questionId": "201", "questionDesc": "Punctuality and syllabus completion"}]
  3. Bulk Submission:
      • POST https://ecampus.psgtech.ac.in/studzone/Feedback/Save_EndSem
      • Payload (application/x-www-form-urlencoded):
          • coursecode: 23U301
          • coursetype: 1
          • staffId: C3565
          • quesID: Caret-delimited string of question IDs (e.g. 201^202^203^204^205)
          • scorWeight: Caret-delimited rating score string (e.g. 4^4^4^4^4, where 4 represents 5-star maximum rating)

  ### 1.2 Scheme Summary Table (table#PDG_Course_credit_cnt)

  ### 1.3 Completed Courses Table (table#PDGCourse)

  Historical record of all completed semesters:

  • Table Selector: table#PDGCourse (inside container #TabCourse)
  • Total Credits Span: span#tot_credit_comp (e.g. 42)
  • Column Index Mapping:
      • td[0]: Serial Number (S.No)
      • td[1]: Course Code (e.g. 23G001)
      • td[2]: Course Title (e.g. COMMUNICATION SKILLS FOR ENGINEERS)
      • td[3]: Category (HS, BS, ES, PC)
      • td[4]: Semester Number (e.g. 1, 2)

  ## 5. Summary & Recommendations for Bunker Web Upgrade

  1. Modern Portal Prefetching:
      • StudentPercentage and TimeTable can be fetched in parallel using a single session token, delivering complete schedules and safe bunk margins
      in under 650ms.
  2. Dynamic CA Marks Parsing:
      • The modern CA marks page contains 5 separate tables (Lab, Theory with Tutorial, Theory with Assignment, Environmental Science, Activity
      Points). Check for the presence of AT1/AT2 vs AP in <th> to accurately calculate internals.
  3. Automated Feedback Integration:
      • Feedback/Intermediate does not require anti-forgery tokens for submission; querying /Feedback/IntermediateAnsList and posting to
      /Feedback/Save_Intermediate enables 1-click batch evaluation.
  4. Classic Portal Results Resiliency:
      • Keep studzone2 as the authority for AttWfStudCourseSelection.aspx and FrmEpsStudResult.aspx, with fallback GPA computation according to PSG
      Tech's rule (** * when registered courses are uncleared).
```

```html:public/calendar.html
                perf = savedPerf;
            } else {
                const ram = navigator.deviceMemory;
                const cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency;
                const saveData = navigator.connection && navigator.connection.saveData;
                const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
                const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !window.MSStream;
                const isAndroid = /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

                if (reducedMotion || saveData || (ram && ram <= 4) || (cores && cores <= 4) || (isAndroid && (!ram || ram <= 6))) {
                    perf = 'low';
                } else if (isIOS || (ram && ram > 4)) {
                    perf = 'high';
                } else {
                    perf = 'low';
                }
            }
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-perf', perf);
```

```html:public/feedback.html
<div class="container">
    <a href="/" class="back-link">← Bunker</a>
    
    <h1>Auto Feedback Bot</h1>

    <form id="feedbackForm">
        <div class="form-group">
            <label for="rollno">Roll No</label>
            <input type="text" id="rollno" placeholder="e.g. 25U201" required autocomplete="username">
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <label for="password">Password</label>
            <div class="input-wrapper">
                <input type="password" id="password" placeholder="••••••••" required autocomplete="current-password">
                <button type="button" class="toggle-pw-btn" id="togglePwBtn" title="Toggle visibility">👁️</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" id="submitBtn">
            <span>Submit</span>
        </button>
    </form>

    <div class="status-box" id="statusBox">
        <div id="statusText"></div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const form = document.getElementById('feedbackForm');
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
    const statusBox = document.getElementById('statusBox');
    const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
    const togglePwBtn = document.getElementById('togglePwBtn');
    const pwInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const rollInput = document.getElementById('rollno');

    // Auto-restore saved roll if available
    const savedRoll = localStorage.getItem('bunker_roll') || localStorage.getItem('psg_feedback_rollno');
    if (savedRoll && savedRoll !== 'DEMO') {
        rollInput.value = savedRoll;
    }
    const savedCreds = localStorage.getItem('bunker_credentials');
    if (savedCreds) {
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(savedCreds);
            if (parsed.roll && (!rollInput.value || rollInput.value === parsed.roll)) {
                rollInput.value = parsed.roll;
                if (parsed.password) pwInput.value = parsed.password;
            }
        } catch {}
    }

    togglePwBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isPw = pwInput.type === 'password';
        pwInput.type = isPw ? 'text' : 'password';
        togglePwBtn.textContent = isPw ? '🔒' : '👁️';
    });

    function showStatus(msg, type = 'info') {
        statusBox.className = 'status-box ' + type;
        statusBox.style.display = 'block';
        statusText.innerHTML = msg;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        const rollno = rollInput.value.trim().toUpperCase();
        const password = pwInput.value.trim();

        if (!rollno || !password) {
            showStatus('Roll number and password are required', 'error');
            return;
        }

        localStorage.setItem('psg_feedback_rollno', rollno);

        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner"></div><span>Submitting...</span>';
        showStatus('Submitting 5-star feedback in parallel...', 'info');

        const startTime = Date.now();

        try {
            const sessionToken = localStorage.getItem('bunker_session_token') || '';
            const res = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ rollno, password, mode: 'auto', rating_style: 'max', session_token: sessionToken })
            });

            const data = await res.json();
            const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
            if (data.session_token) {
                localStorage.setItem('bunker_session_token', data.session_token);
            }

            if (res.ok && data.success) {
                showStatus(`🎉 <strong>Success (${elapsed}s)!</strong><br>${data.message || 'Feedback submitted successfully!'}`, 'success');
                if (typeof confetti === 'function') {
                    confetti({
                        particleCount: 90,
                        spread: 70,
                        origin: { y: 0.6 }
                    });
                }
            } else {
                showStatus(`❌ <strong>Failed:</strong> ${data.error || 'Server rejected submission'}`, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showStatus(`❌ <strong>Error:</strong> ${err.message}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            submitBtn.innerHTML = '<span>Submit</span>';
        }
    });
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html:public/index.html
    <script>
        // PWA Manager
        window.pwaManager = {
            deferredPrompt: null,
            isIOS: /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !window.MSStream,
            isStandalone: window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone,
            isAppInstalled: false, // Will be updated after detection
            init: function () {
                // Register Service Worker for total offline functionality
                if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
                        navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js?v=13').then((reg) => {
                            console.log('PWA: Service Worker registered.', reg.scope);
                        }).catch((err) => {
                            console.log('PWA: Service Worker registration failed: ', err);
                        });
                    });
                }

                // Check if app is already installed (even if user is in browser)
                this.checkIfInstalled();

                window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.deferredPrompt = e;
                    this.isAppInstalled = false; // If this event fires, app is NOT installed
                    console.log("PWA: Install prompt captured");
                    // Trigger UI update if needed
                    if (typeof updateInstallUI === 'function') updateInstallUI();
                });

                window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
                    this.deferredPrompt = null;
                    this.isAppInstalled = true;
                    console.log("PWA: App installed");
                    if (typeof updateInstallUI === 'function') updateInstallUI();
                });
            },

            checkIfInstalled: async function () {
                // Method 1: Check if running in standalone (already installed and opened)
                if (this.isStandalone) {
                    this.isAppInstalled = true;
                    if (typeof updateInstallUI === 'function') updateInstallUI();
                    return;
                }

                // Method 2: Use getInstalledRelatedApps API (Chrome 80+)
                if ('getInstalledRelatedApps' in navigator) {
                    try {
                        const relatedApps = await navigator.getInstalledRelatedApps();
                        this.isAppInstalled = relatedApps.length > 0;
                        if (this.isAppInstalled) {
                            console.log('PWA: App is installed (detected via getInstalledRelatedApps)');
                            if (typeof updateInstallUI === 'function') updateInstallUI();
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log('PWA: getInstalledRelatedApps failed', e);
                    }
                }

                // Method 3: Fallback - if beforeinstallprompt doesn't fire after 2 seconds,
                // assume app might be installed (not 100% reliable but helps)
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (!this.deferredPrompt && !this.isStandalone && !this.isAppInstalled) {
                        // No prompt fired and not in standalone - might be installed
                        // Check if Service Worker is registered (indicates previous install)
                        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                            navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(regs => {
                                if (regs.length > 0) {
                                    this.isAppInstalled = true;
                                    console.log('PWA: App likely installed (SW registered, no prompt)');
                                    if (typeof updateInstallUI === 'function') updateInstallUI();
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }, 2000);
            },

            install: async function () {
                if (this.deferredPrompt) {
                    this.deferredPrompt.prompt();
                    const { outcome } = await this.deferredPrompt.userChoice;
                    console.log(`PWA: User response to install prompt: ${outcome}`);
                    this.deferredPrompt = null;
                } else {
                    // Fallback feedback
                    if (window.showToast) {
                        const isHttp = location.protocol === 'http:' && location.hostname !== 'localhost';
                        if (isHttp) showToast("Install requires HTTPS or Localhost", "error");
                        else showToast("App install not ready or already installed using browser menu");
                    } else {
                        alert("Install via browser menu (Add to Home Screen)");
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        window.pwaManager.init();

        // Unregister the old stale /static/sw.js service worker (duplicate that was serving old cached assets)
        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(regs => {
                regs.forEach(reg => {
                    if (reg.scope.includes('/static/')) reg.unregister();
                });
            });
        }

    </script>

    <!-- Performance Optimization Script -->
    <script>
        (function () {
            // Retrieve user preference from storage
            const savedPerf = localStorage.getItem('bunker_perf_mode');
            let perf = 'low'; // Default safe mode

            if (savedPerf) {
                perf = savedPerf;
            } else {
                // Auto-detect Low-RAM / budget phones for silky smooth 60fps
                const ram = navigator.deviceMemory;
                const cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency;
                const saveData = navigator.connection && navigator.connection.saveData;
                const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
                const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !window.MSStream;

                const isAndroid = /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
                if (reducedMotion || saveData) {
                    perf = 'low';
                } else if (ram && ram <= 4) {
                    perf = 'low';
                } else if (cores && cores <= 4) {
                    perf = 'low';
                } else if (isAndroid && (!ram || ram <= 6)) {
                    // Budget and mid-range Android devices: default to solid, silky-smooth 60fps mode without heavy blurs
                    perf = 'low';
                } else if (isIOS || (ram && ram > 4)) {
                    perf = 'high';
                } else {
                    perf = 'low'; // Safe 60fps default for unknown/low devices
                }
            }

            // Apply mode immediately before render
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-perf', perf);
            console.log(`Smart Bunker: Performance Mode set to ${perf.toUpperCase()} (RAM: ${navigator.deviceMemory || 'Unknown'}, Cores: ${navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 'Unknown'})`);
        })();
    </script>

        </div>

        <div style="position:relative;z-index:10;width:100%;max-width:360px;padding:0 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;">
            
            <!-- Animated Concentric Orbital Rings -->

                        <span id="sim-fraction" class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">0 / 0</span>
                        <span id="sim-diff" class="text-[8.5px] font-black px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/5 mt-1 uppercase border border-white/10 text-gray-300">Current</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Live Safe Bunk Status Pill -->
            <div id="sim-verdict-banner" class="mb-3 py-2 px-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 text-center text-[10px] font-black text-emerald-300 uppercase tracking-wider relative z-10">
                Safe to bunk
            </div>

            <!-- Strict 75% Exam & 65% Medical Dual-Threshold Diagnostic Grid -->
            <div id="sim-dual-thresholds" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-3 relative z-10">
                <div class="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10">
                    <div class="text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300">75% Exam Zone</div>
                    <div id="sim-diag-75" class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5">--</div>
                    <div id="sim-eta-75" class="text-[8.5px] font-semibold text-gray-400 mt-0.5 truncate">--</div>
                </div>
                <div class="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10">
                    <div class="text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">65% Medical Floor</div>
                    <div id="sim-diag-65" class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5">--</div>
                    <div id="sim-eta-65" class="text-[8.5px] font-semibold text-gray-400 mt-0.5 truncate">--</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- End-of-Semester Remaining Classes Projection -->
            <div id="sim-semester-projection" class="mb-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] font-bold text-indigo-200 relative z-10">
                <span id="sim-rem-classes-label">Est. Left in Sem: -- hrs</span>
                <span id="sim-max-sem-pct" class="font-black text-white">Max Possible: --%</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Tactile Controls -->
            <div class="space-y-2.5 relative z-10">
                <div class="bg-white/5 rounded-3xl p-2 pr-3 flex items-center justify-between pl-4 border border-white/10">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 text-xs">
                            <i class="fas fa-check"></i>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider" id="sim-attend-label">Attend</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button onclick="updateBunkSim('attend', -1)" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-white active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-minus text-[10px]"></i></button>
                        <span id="val-attend" class="w-7 text-center font-black text-white text-base">0</span>
                        <button onclick="updateBunkSim('attend', 1)" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500 text-black font-black shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/25 active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-plus text-[10px]"></i></button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="bg-white/5 rounded-3xl p-2 pr-3 flex items-center justify-between pl-4 border border-white/10">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-400 text-xs" id="sim-bunk-icon-wrap">
                            <i class="fas fa-times" id="sim-bunk-icon"></i>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider" id="sim-bunk-label">Bunk</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button onclick="updateBunkSim('bunk', -1)" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-white active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-minus text-[10px]"></i></button>
                        <span id="val-bunk" class="w-7 text-center font-black text-white text-base">0</span>
                        <button onclick="updateBunkSim('bunk', 1)" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500 text-black font-black shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/25 active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-plus text-[10px]"></i></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="mt-4 text-center relative z-10">
                <button type="button" onclick="resetSimModal()" class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 hover:text-white py-1.5 px-4 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 active:scale-95 transition inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <i class="fas fa-rotate-left text-[9px]"></i>
                    <span>Reset Simulation</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- SEM MARKS & PASS TARGET PREDICTOR POP-UP MODAL (40:60 RULE) -->
    <div id="pass-matrix-modal" class="fixed inset-0 z-[70] hidden flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4">
        <div class="absolute inset-0 modal-backdrop-blur" id="pass-matrix-backdrop" onclick="closePassMatrixModal()"></div>
        <div class="w-full max-w-[420px] relative z-10 modal-spring-card p-5 space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar" id="pass-matrix-panel">

            <!-- Header -->
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-rose-600 via-rose-500 to-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-sm shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/30">
                        <i class="fas fa-bullseye"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-sm font-black text-white tracking-tight">Sem Marks Predictor</h3>
                        <p class="text-[9px] text-rose-300 font-black uppercase tracking-widest">PSG Tech 40:60 Ceiling Calculator</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="closePassMatrixModal()" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-times text-xs"></i></button>
            </div>

            <!-- Active Subject Badge (when selected) -->

                <div class="min-w-0">
                    <span class="text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 mr-1.5" id="pass-matrix-active-code">CODE</span>
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate" id="pass-matrix-active-name">Subject Name</span>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onclick="applyPassMatrixToActiveSubject()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-400 text-white text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 active:scale-95 transition">
                    Apply to Sim
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Interactive CA Score Adjuster & Live Pass Hero -->
            <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 space-y-3.5 relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <span class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 block" id="pm-selected-label">Your Internal CA Mark</span>
                        <div class="flex items-baseline gap-1 mt-0.5">
                            <span class="text-3xl font-black text-indigo-300 tabular-nums" id="pass-matrix-input-val">22</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500">/ 40</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-right">
                        <span class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-300 block">Min Sem Exam to Pass</span>
                        <div class="flex items-baseline justify-end gap-1 mt-0.5">
                            <span class="text-3xl font-black text-white tabular-nums" id="pm-res-sem100">46</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-rose-400">/ 100</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tactile - / Slider / + Controls -->
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <button type="button" onclick="stepPassMatrixCA(-0.5)" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-white font-black text-sm flex items-center justify-center active:scale-90 transition shrink-0">
                        <i class="fas fa-minus text-[10px]"></i>
                    </button>
                    <input type="range" id="pass-matrix-slider" min="0" max="40" step="0.5" value="22" oninput="updatePassMatrix(this.value)" class="flex-1 accent-rose-500 cursor-pointer acad-slider">
                    <button type="button" onclick="stepPassMatrixCA(0.5)" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-white font-black text-sm flex items-center justify-center active:scale-90 transition shrink-0">
                        <i class="fas fa-plus text-[10px]"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Quick CA Presets -->
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(16)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">16</button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(20)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">20</button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(24)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">24</button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(28)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">28</button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(32)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">32</button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="updatePassMatrix(36)" class="pm-pill flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-300 active:scale-95 transition">36</button>
                </div>

                <!-- Exact PSG 40:60 Ceiling Proof Pill -->
                <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px]">
                    <span class="text-gray-400 font-bold">PSG 40:60 Math:</span>
                    <span class="font-black text-emerald-300 tabular-nums" id="pm-formula-proof">46 × 0.6 = 27.6 ➔ 28 + 22 CA = 50 (PASS)</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Sem Exam Marks Needed for Every Grade -->
                <div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <span class="text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400">Exam Score (/100) Needed for Grade</span>
                        <span id="pm-res-badge" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[8px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">Target</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 text-center">
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-blue-400 block uppercase">C+ (6 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-cplus">56</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-teal-400 block uppercase">B (6.5 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-b">65</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-emerald-400 block uppercase">B+ (7 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-bplus">73</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-indigo-400 block uppercase">A (8 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-a">81</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-purple-400 block uppercase">A+ (9 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-aplus">98</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5">
                            <span class="text-[8px] font-black text-amber-400 block uppercase">S / O (10 GP)</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-black text-white mt-0.5 block tabular-nums" id="pm-grade-s">--</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Auto Subject-Wise Short Summary Matrix -->
            <div class="space-y-2 relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                    <span class="text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400">Your Subjects (Tap to Load CA)</span>
                    <span class="text-[8.5px] font-bold text-rose-300">Pass &amp; Grade Targets</span>
                </div>
                <div id="pm-auto-subjects-list" class="space-y-1.5 max-h-[210px] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar pr-0.5"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- FEEDBACK BOT POP-UP MODAL -->
    <div id="feedback-modal" class="fixed inset-0 z-[70] hidden flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4">
        <div class="absolute inset-0 modal-backdrop-blur" id="feedback-backdrop" onclick="closeFeedbackModal()"></div>
        <div class="w-full max-w-[410px] relative z-10 modal-spring-card p-6 space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar" id="feedback-panel">
            <div class="absolute -top-16 -right-16 w-36 h-36 rounded-full bg-purple-500/25 blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>

            <div class="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-purple-600 via-pink-600 to-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-base shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/30">

                    </div>

                <button onclick="closeFeedbackModal()" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 active:scale-90 transition"><i class="fas fa-times text-xs"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div id="feedback-confirm-view" class="space-y-4 relative z-10">
                <div class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-300 text-sm">
                            <i class="fas fa-user-check"></i>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Active Account</div>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[8px] font-black bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 uppercase tracking-widest">Verified</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Auto-Detected Pending Feedback Banner -->
                <div id="feedback-auto-banner" class="hidden p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-200 space-y-1">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">
                        <i class="fas fa-bell animate-bounce text-xs"></i>
                        <span id="feedback-auto-banner-title">Pending Feedback Available</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-amber-100/90 font-medium" id="feedback-auto-banner-text">
                        Active surveys detected on Studzone. Click Confirm to auto-complete them with 5-star ratings.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/25 space-y-1.5">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-200">⚡ Parallel 5-Star Filler</span>
                        <span class="text-[9px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">Ready</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-300 leading-relaxed">Submits <b>5-Star (Strongly Agree)</b> ratings across all active faculty evaluations on Studzone in under 1 second.</p>
                </div>

                <button type="button" id="feedback-confirm-btn" onclick="executeCurrentFeedback()" class="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl btn-liquid text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition">
                    <i class="fas fa-bolt"></i>
                    <span>Confirm &amp; Submit 5-Star Feedback</span>
                </button>

                <button type="button" onclick="switchFeedbackMode('other')" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 active:scale-95 text-gray-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition">
                    <i class="fas fa-user-plus text-xs text-indigo-400"></i>
                    <span>Complete for Another Roll No</span>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- VIEW 2: OTHER PERSON VIEW -->
            <div id="feedback-other-view" class="hidden space-y-4 relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-1">
                    <span class="text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <i class="fas fa-user-friends text-purple-400 text-xs"></i>
                        <span>Another Student Feedback</span>
                    </span>
                    <button type="button" onclick="switchFeedbackMode('self')" class="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left text-[9px]"></i>
                        <span>Back to My Account</span>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <form id="bunker-other-feedback-form" onsubmit="executeOtherFeedback(event)" class="space-y-3">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5">Roll Number</label>
                        <input type="text" id="feedback-other-roll" required placeholder="e.g. 23Z101" class="w-full h-11 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider placeholder:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500/50">
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5">Studzone Password</label>
                        <div class="relative">
                            <input type="password" id="feedback-other-password" required placeholder="••••••••" class="w-full h-11 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-4 pr-11 text-xs font-bold text-white tracking-wider placeholder:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500/50">
                            <button type="button" onclick="toggleOtherFeedbackPassword()" class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition p-1">
                                <i id="feedback-other-pw-icon" class="fas fa-eye text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5">Rating Mode</label>
                        <select id="feedback-other-mode" class="w-full h-11 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500/50">
                            <option value="5" class="bg-[#0f1019] text-white" selected>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars (Strongly Agree)</option>
                            <option value="4" class="bg-[#0f1019] text-white">⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4 Stars (Agree)</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>

                    <button type="submit" id="feedback-other-submit-btn" class="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl btn-liquid text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition mt-2">
                        <i class="fas fa-bolt"></i>
                        <span>Submit 5-Star Feedback</span>
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>

            <!-- Status Box -->
            <div id="feedback-status-box" class="hidden p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-medium space-y-1 relative z-10">
                <div id="feedback-status-text"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
```

```javascript:server.js
import express from 'express';
import * as cheerio from 'cheerio';

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import zlib from 'zlib';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

// Allow college portal certificates (equivalent to verify=False in Python requests)
process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '0';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const PUBLIC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'public');
const STATIC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'static');

const app = express();
app.disable('x-powered-by');

const SESSION_SECRET =
  process.env.BUNKER_SECRET_KEY ||
  process.env.SESSION_SECRET ||
  'fallback-deterministic-secret-key-psg-bunker-2026';

// ============================================================================
// 1. VERCEL PATH NORMALIZATION & GZIP COMPRESSION MIDDLEWARE
//    Minimizes Vercel Hobby Fast Origin Transfer (10 GB/mo limit) by ~95%
// ============================================================================
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  // Normalize Vercel rewrite query param (?__vercel_path=api/...)
  if (req.query && typeof req.query.__vercel_path === 'string') {
    const cleanPath = '/' + req.query.__vercel_path.replace(/^\/+/, '');
    const urlObj = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost');
    urlObj.searchParams.delete('__vercel_path');
    const qs = urlObj.searchParams.toString();
    req.url = cleanPath + (qs ? `?${qs}` : '');
  } else if (req.headers['x-invoke-path'] && req.url.startsWith('/api/index')) {
    req.url = String(req.headers['x-invoke-path']);
  }

  // Intercept res.json and res.send to apply fast Gzip compression (>= 128 bytes)
  const acceptEncoding = String(req.headers['accept-encoding'] || '').toLowerCase();
  const supportsGzip =
    acceptEncoding.includes('gzip') ||
    Boolean(req.headers['x-vercel-id']) ||
    Boolean(req.headers['x-vercel-deployment-url']);

  if (supportsGzip) {
    const origSend = res.send.bind(res);
    res.send = function (body) {
      if (res.headersSent || res.statusCode >= 400 || res.getHeader('Content-Encoding')) {
        return origSend(body);
      }
      let buf = null;
      if (Buffer.isBuffer(body)) {
        buf = body;
      } else if (typeof body === 'string') {
        buf = Buffer.from(body, 'utf-8');
      } else if (body !== undefined && body !== null) {
        buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(body), 'utf-8');
        if (!res.getHeader('Content-Type')) {
          res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
        }
      }

      if (buf && buf.length >= 128) {
        try {
          const compressed = zlib.gzipSync(buf, { level: 6 });
          if (compressed.length < buf.length) {
            res.setHeader('Content-Encoding', 'gzip');
            res.setHeader('Content-Length', String(compressed.length));
            res.setHeader('Vary', 'Accept-Encoding');
            return origSend(compressed);
          }
        } catch {
          // Fallback to uncompressed on error
        }
      }
      return origSend(body);
    };
  }

  next();
});

app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));

// ============================================================================
// 2. BOUNDED IN-MEMORY & /tmp DISK CACHE + IN-FLIGHT REQUEST COALESCING
// ============================================================================
const IN_MEM_CACHE = new Map();
const MAX_MEM_CACHE_ITEMS = 800;
const IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS = new Map();

function coalesceRequest(key, asyncFn) {
  if (IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS.has(key)) {
    return IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS.get(key);
  }
  const promise = Promise.resolve()
    .then(asyncFn)
    .finally(() => {
      IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS.delete(key);
    });
  IN_FLIGHT_REQUESTS.set(key, promise);
  return promise;
}

function getDiskCache(cacheKey, maxAgeSeconds = 86400) {
  const now = Date.now() / 1000;
  if (IN_MEM_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) {
    const entry = IN_MEM_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
    if (now - (entry.ts || 0) < maxAgeSeconds) {
      return entry.data;
    }
    IN_MEM_CACHE.delete(cacheKey);
  }
  try {
    const filePath = `/tmp/${cacheKey}.json`;
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
      if (now - stat.mtimeMs / 1000 < maxAgeSeconds) {
        const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8'));
        setMemCacheBounded(cacheKey, { ts: now, data });
        return data;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore disk cache miss
  }
  return null;
}

function setMemCacheBounded(cacheKey, val) {
  if (IN_MEM_CACHE.size >= MAX_MEM_CACHE_ITEMS && !IN_MEM_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) {
    const oldestKey = IN_MEM_CACHE.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey) IN_MEM_CACHE.delete(oldestKey);
  }
  IN_MEM_CACHE.set(cacheKey, val);
}

function setDiskCache(cacheKey, data) {
  const now = Date.now() / 1000;
  setMemCacheBounded(cacheKey, { ts: now, data });
  try {
    const filePath = `/tmp/${cacheKey}.json`;
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data), 'utf-8');
  } catch {
    // Ignore disk write error
  }
}

function formatPortalDate(rawDate) {
  const trimmed = String(rawDate || '').trim();
  const m = trimmed.match(/^(\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{4})$/);
  if (m) {
    const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
    const day = m[1];
    const monthIdx = parseInt(m[2], 10) - 1;
    const year = m[3];
    if (monthIdx >= 0 && monthIdx < 12) {
      return `${months[monthIdx]} ${day}, ${year}`;
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function parsePortalDateRank(rawDate) {
  const trimmed = String(rawDate || '').trim();
  const m = trimmed.match(/^(\d{2})[-/](\d{2})[-/](\d{4})$/);
  if (m) {
    return parseInt(`${m[3]}${m[2]}${m[1]}`, 10);
  }
  return 0;
}

function fastExtractLastUpdateDate(html) {
  if (!html) return null;
  try {
    const tableStart = html.indexOf('id="example"');
    const altStart = tableStart === -1 ? html.indexOf('cssbody') : tableStart;
    const sliceStart = altStart !== -1 ? altStart : 0;
    const tableEnd = html.indexOf('</table>', sliceStart);
    const tableHtml = tableEnd !== -1 ? html.slice(sliceStart, tableEnd) : html.slice(sliceStart);

    let bestDateRaw = null;
    let bestRank = -1;
    let trMatch;
    TR_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((trMatch = TR_RE.exec(tableHtml)) !== null) {
      const trContent = trMatch[1];
      if (trContent.indexOf('<td') === -1) continue;
      const tds = [];

      TD_RE.lastIndex = 0;

        if (rank > bestRank) {
          bestRank = rank;
          bestDateRaw = tds[9];
        }
      }
    }
    if (bestDateRaw) {
      return formatPortalDate(bestDateRaw);
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback
  }
  return null;
}

function fastExtractAttendanceSignature(html) {
  if (!html) return { sig: null, totHours: 0, attHours: 0, lastUpdate: null };
```
